blockingLoop.evidence: Turn 4 repeated turn 3 almost verbatim ('That suggests the issue: the plastic door catch (tongue) has snapped off') plus the same panel three times, but the customer was already going to fetch the model so progress was not actually blocked

rationale: The assistant opened with exactly the right questions (lights/sounds, door click), correctly reasoned from the loose door and missing click to the door catch, told the customer to unplug before inspecting, and confirmed the snapped tongue without naming a part before getting the model number. Weaknesses: it never warned the customer not to tape or hold the door shut as a workaround after they said it runs while held, the heading 'Likely cause: door handle' mislabels the catch, and the final two turns repeated the same paragraph and panel after the customer had already said they would go and look. Diagnosis is correct and the next step is sound, but the exchange ended unfinished waiting on the model number.
